_about: Plain-English meanings for module codes AutoPi can show offline. U-codes are SAE J2012 standard; the B2A/B22 Subaru telematics (DCM) entries are as reported in Subaru repair guides - the AI and your mechanic should confirm.
U0001: High-speed CAN network fault (modules can't talk on the main bus).
U0100: Lost communication with the engine computer (ECM). On 2020+ Outbacks often a weak battery.
U0101: Lost communication with the transmission computer (TCM).
U0121: Lost communication with the ABS module.
U0122: Lost communication with the stability-control (VDC) module.
U0140: Lost communication with the body control module.
U0151: Lost communication with the airbag (SRS) module.
U0155: Lost communication with the instrument cluster.
U0164: Lost communication with the climate control (HVAC) module.
U0184: Lost communication with the radio / infotainment.
U0198: Lost communication with the telematics module (Starlink DCM).
U0401: Invalid data received from the engine computer.
B2A0C: Telematics (DCM): internal fault in the module.
B2A16: Telematics (DCM): immobilizer key-check failed - often after a low-voltage event.
B2256: Telematics (DCM): can't talk to the infotainment display unit.
